# Liberation Mono

`boot-image/font.ttf` is Liberation Mono Regular, used by NaumiOS's kernel
TrueType rasterizer (`kernel/gfx/ttf.c`) as the system UI font. It is
copied here unmodified from the `ttf-liberation` package.

Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 — see `LICENSE` in
this directory. The OFL requires this notice and the license text to
accompany any distribution that includes the font.
